review: The hymn is the soul's self-exhortation: 1:1–4 is Ps 103:2 (אַל־תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל־גְּמוּלָיו) with Ps 136, the chorus is Ps 145:18 with Jas 4:8, 2:1–4 is Ps 103:7 with Isa 55:8–9, 3:1–4 is Ps 34:6 (הִבִּיטוּ אֵלָיו וְנָהָרוּ) with Ps 3:4, and 4:1–4 is Ps 145:16 with Phil 4:19.
The chorus follows stanza 1 as the print's [القرار]; the payload keeps its first line identical to 1:1, so the stanza and its refrain begin with the same summons.

1:2 keeps the feminine singular of the self-address (זִכְרִי … אַל־תִּשְׁכָּחִי), as the print's يَا نَفْسِي governs a feminine soul throughout; the psalm's own masculine form is adjusted to the hymn's gender.
